business_summary.text: Raj Rayon Industries Limited is a polyester yarn manufacturer with operations in Silvassa, specializing in POY, DTY, and specialty yarns. The company underwent a turnaround under SVG Group ownership post-NCLT insolvency proceedings.

Dope dyed yarn capacity to double in Q3FY27 with full dull cotton like yarns well received
